sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
Only [Partners] Hajime Nagumo & Yue can be used as Unlocking Potential material
